summary: Verified bugfixes for admin login and transparent dropdown/overlay issues. Both bugs are now fixed. Admin login correctly checks result?.token instead of result.success. All churvox-* Tailwind colors are defined. Dropdowns and dialogs have solid dark backgrounds with readable text.
passed_tests: Admin login (admin@churvox.com / Admin123!) works and redirects to /dashboard
Worker login (john@churvox.com / Worker123!) works and redirects to /dashboard
Wrong password shows error message 'Invalid email or password'
Signup flow works - new user registered and redirected to /dashboard
New user dashboard shows 'Getting Started' onboarding card
Protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated
Public routes redirect to /dashboard when already authenticated
Jobs page status filter dropdown has solid dark background - readable
SMS Send dialog has solid dark background - readable
SMS message type dropdown has solid dark background - readable
Plan change confirmation dialog has solid dark background - readable
All sidebar navigation links work correctly
churvox-bg, churvox-card, churvox-border, churvox-muted, churvox-accent colors defined in tailwind.config.js
--popover CSS variable set to 12% lightness for better contrast

bugs_verified_fixed.bug: Admin login broken - navigating to /dashboard showed login screen
bugs_verified_fixed.root_cause: LoginPage.js checked result.success which didn't exist on API response
bugs_verified_fixed.fix: Changed to try/catch with result?.token check

bugs_verified_fixed.bug: Dropdown/select/popover menus were transparent and hard to read
bugs_verified_fixed.root_cause: churvox-* Tailwind colors were used but never defined in tailwind.config.js
bugs_verified_fixed.fix: Added 5 churvox color definitions + bumped --popover lightness from 9% to 12%
